scope: Original five published mission targets, unchanged statements.

targets.formal_statement:
theorem HlawkaSchatten.DiagonalCutoff21.scalar_window21 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 21 ≤ p → p ≤ 26 →
      (273 / 625 : ℝ) * p < cyclicConstant p ∧
      cyclicConstant p ≤ p / 2 ∧
      scalarEnvelope p (1011 / 2500 : ℝ) < cyclicConstant p := by sorry

theorem HlawkaSchatten.DiagonalCutoff21.scalar_window26 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 26 ≤ p → p ≤ 32 →
      (443 / 1000 : ℝ) * p < cyclicConstant p ∧
      cyclicConstant p ≤ p / 2 ∧
      scalarEnvelope p (197 / 500 : ℝ) < cyclicConstant p := by sorry

theorem HlawkaSchatten.DiagonalCutoff21.real_three_window21 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 21 ≤ p → p ≤ 26 →
      HasHlawkaConstant (lpNorm p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
        (cyclicConstant p) := by sorry

theorem HlawkaSchatten.DiagonalCutoff21.real_three_window26 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 26 ≤ p → p ≤ 32 →
      HasHlawkaConstant (lpNorm p : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ)
        (cyclicConstant p) := by sorry

theorem HlawkaSchatten.DiagonalConstruction.campaign_cutoff21 :
    ∀ p : ℝ, 21 ≤ p →
      IsLeast {C : ℝ | ∀ n : ℕ,
        HasHlawkaConstant (lpNorm p : (Fin n → ℂ) → ℝ) C}
        (cyclicConstant p) := by sorry
